svg.text: Radiation-Phase Molecular Response Predicts TNT Outcome in MSS LARC
Integrated WES + RNA-seq of 35 locally advanced rectal cancers (pre / post CRT biopsies)
WES 77 samples · RNA-seq 56 · 49 PASS VCFs · all MSS
radiation induces sequential tumor clearance & immune reprogramming
Treg P = 0.026 · MHC-II up · CD8 exhaustion up
Take-home: Radiation-phase molecular response -- mutation/neoantigen clearance + reproducible CD8-cytotoxic axis --
defines a mid-treatment biomarker window to personalise consolidation chemotherapy in MSS locally advanced rectal cancer.
